image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming in deep blue water, viewed from above and slightly to the side. The shark's distinctive hammer-shaped head (cephalofoil) is clearly visible, with eyes at the lateral tips. The body is streamlined with visible dorsal and pectoral fins. The caudal fin is partially visible at the rear. The image has a greenish-blue tint typical of underwater photography.
